newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - ING keeps 3 Brazil telcos as buys.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ING keeps 3 Brazil telcos as buys.

text.p: ING Barings said it has maintained its buy recommendation on shares of telecoms Telepar, Telemig and Telerj, units of federal holding Telebras.

-- ING analyst Vera Rossi cited expected growth in cellular lines, new rates for long-distance revenue transfers to Embratel and likely drops in cellular rates as the partial basis for her recommendations on all three firms.

-- "We took into consideration a decrease of 10 percent in monthly rental and 25 percent in installation fees in 1998, due to the opening of competition," she wrote in three seperate reports on the firms.

-- For Telerj, she also cited cellular expansion and network improvements programmed for this year and the likelihood competition will only begin in cellular services in mid-1998, allowing time to expand its number of lines.
-- ING has set a 12-month price target of between $176 and $195 per 1,000 shares, indicating a potential total return of 20.7 percent, for Telerj, which serves Rio de Janeiro state.

-- Rossi also said Telemig will lose 4.8 percent of its revenue due to the end of Telebras' auto-financing line rental system but installation fees will start to pour in during the third quarter of 1997.
-- The bank has maintained its June 1998 price target of $227 to $248 per 1,000 shares, indicating a potential total return of 38.3 percent on Telemig, serving Minas Gerais state.
-- "The key point on Telepar continues to be the expansion of (its) cellular network," Rossi said, adding it has offered a 600 million-real cellular equipment contract to be signed July 1997.
-- ING said it has set a 12-month target price for Telepar's of between $1,080 and $1,176 per 1,000 shares, for a potential return of 47.5 percent. Telepar operates in Parana state.
-- The spread between Telepar preferred and common is approximately 16 percent while the average of local copanies is five percent, "therefore we strongly recommend Telepar common," Rossi said.
-- Telepar preferred was flat at 800 reais whle its common was off 1.37percent at 720 reais at 1503 local/1403 edt in Sao Paulo.
-- Telerj preferred was up 0.91 percent at 167 reais and its common was off 1.21 percent at 163 reais while Telemig common was 0.56 percent higher at 180 reais at 1504 local/1404 edt in Sao Paulo.
